articles.title: Toyota Motor Corporation Chairman Akio Toyoda Inducted into the Automotive Hall of Fame
articles.description: TORONTO, September 24, 2026 – In recognition of his global automotive leadership that has brought passion, performance and purpose into modern mobility, Akio Toyoda, chairman of the board, Toyota Motor Corporation (TMC), was inducted into the Automotive Hall of Fame last night in Detroit.

articles.title: Toyota Canada releases August sales results
articles.description: TORONTO, September 1, 2026 – Electrified vehicles led August sales for Toyota Canada Inc. (TCI), reaching a record of 14,461 electrified units sold last month, up 35.6% year over year (YOY).
